text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hip, hip, hooray! Ruby! Happy birthday!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Were you pleased with it? With the result 
of everyone's advice, that is.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I asked everyone what would make you 
happy, Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
First, to Helios-san, I said, 'Sunnies are 
a MUST if you're gonna party☆' and—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo-san gave me some advice, saying, 
"Cheering them on is the best way to make 
someone happy!"—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san, who happened to be nearby, 
chimed in, "Hand fans are great for 
cheering too!" And that's how this came to 
be.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
One more time! Go! Go! Ruby! Happy 
birthday!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I gratefully accept the kindness of you 
both.
